Subject: plasma physics | ID: 59487

Corollary

Step 3. Consider the singular operator \(Q_{01300013}\) acting on the locally compact space. By the singular decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|Q_{01300013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01300013\).

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the geometric convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
